command_line:
set -eu
{
  echo PWD=$PWD
  echo HOME=$HOME
  echo PATH=$PATH
  echo '--- uname ---'
  uname -a
  echo '--- python ---'
  python --version 2>&1 || true
  echo '--- caper ---'
  which caper || true
  caper --version 2>&1 || true
  echo '--- croo ---'
  which croo || true
  croo --version 2>&1 || true
  echo '--- top dirs ---'
  ls -la /
  echo '--- find atac wdl ---'
  find / -maxdepth 5 \( -name atac.wdl -o -name '*.wdl' -o -iname '*atac*' \) 2>/dev/null | head -200
  echo '--- conda envs ---'
  conda env list 2>&1 || true
  ls -la /opt 2>/dev/null || true
  ls -la /usr/local/bin 2>/dev/null | head -100 || true
} > probe.txt
